chapter: Lester Nelson and New Orleans players
title: Playing with Nelson and Tony Fougerat's pallbearers
summary: Nelson played in Tony's band; who carried Tony's casket.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: Well, and Lester Nelson, you told me you played with him, though. Oh, many times. Many, many times. With different leaders?
Yeah. Mostly in the same band?
Tony was Tony's band, Tony Fusirat's band. Mm-hmm.
I can't even remember who the pallbearers were for Tony now other than you and I. I asked Don Lockie to come. I thought it'd be nice.
You and I and the boy from England. What does he play? Not Barry.
Played clarinet. Plays clarinet. Oh, I know who you're talking about. The fellow from Nottingham. That plays, he's from the same town as Andrew Hall. That's right. Wasn't Andrew Hall?
Chris Burt. Yeah, Andrew. And wasn't Andrew Paul Barrow?
